title: .sl/reviews/<readback_id>.json
description: A review form written by sl review export --format json, or read back from the Markdown form: each item of a pending readback with an empty or filled verdict and answer, and the open questions of the models and access.yaml the items belong to.

readback_id.description: The readback the form was exported from, .sl/pending/<readback_id>.json.

created_at.description: When the form was exported, as an ISO timestamp.

n.description: The item's number in the readback.

target.description: The approve target: source.model, source.model.field, metric:<name> or access.

content_hash.description: The target's content hash when it was read back, as the pending readback holds it.

text.description: The readback text exactly as the pending readback holds it.

verdict.description: The owner's verdict: yes (right as written), no (wrong), change (right once something changes), or null while unanswered.

answer.description: The owner's own words, empty while unanswered.

ref.description: Where the question is held: source.model (the model's open_questions), access (access.yaml's top-level open_questions) or access.roles.<role> (that role's open_questions).

key.description: q_ and the SHA-256 of the question text as stored, cut to 16 hex characters, so the question can be found again.

answer.description: The owner's answer, empty while unanswered.
